svg.title: What happens when something fails: in each of four scenarios (a host fails, an entire data AZ goes down, the witness AZ goes down, the link between the data AZs is cut), the stretched cluster reacts on its own, with no data lost and no action from you

g.text: vSphere HA restarts its VMs on the other hosts
An entire data AZ goes down
Its VMs restart automatically in the surviving AZ
Both data AZs keep running and keep the quorum
The link between data AZs is cut
AZ A keeps the quorum; AZ B’s VMs restart in AZ A
